message.reasoning_content: We need to determine statutory charge(s) for the fact. Chinese law: a public security/administrative enforcement officer who fails to transfer criminal cases to judicial organs, i.e., "徇私舞弊，不移交应当追究刑事责任的案件" is a crime of "徇私枉法罪" (abuse of power, dereliction of duty). Specifically, under Criminal Law of PRC, Article 397 (formerly 399) "徇私舞弊罪" (abuse of power, dereliction of duty) includes "国家机关工作人员滥用职权或者玩忽职守，致使公共财产、国家和人民利益遭受重大损失的" etc. Also there is "徇私枉法罪" (Article 399) for "国家机关工作人员徇私舞弊，不依法移送应当追究刑事责任的案件" (failure to transfer criminal cases). The fact matches that. So charge: "徇私枉法罪". Possibly also "玩忽职守罪"? But the description says "徇私枉法罪". The prosecutor says "已构成××". Likely they intend "徇私枉法罪". So answer: [罪名]徇私枉法罪<eoa>
